items.title: Incyte Corporation (INCY) has the Bigger Revenue Base, but Could Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (HALO) have the Better Economics?
items.summary: On July 20, Halozyme Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:HALO) and Incyte Corporation (NASDAQ:INCY) announced a global collaboration and licensing deal to develop a subcutaneous formulation of Incyte’s INCA033989. The first-in-class monoclonal antibody targets mutant calreticulin (mutCALR)-expressing myeloproliferative neoplasms. items.title: Incyte (INCY) Wins EU Approval For Opzelura In Adult Moderate Atopic Dermatitis
items.summary: European Commission approves Opzelura (ruxolitinib) cream as the first steroid free topical JAK inhibitor for adults with moderate atopic dermatitis in the EU. Decision is based on Phase 3b TRuE AD4 data in adult patients with mild to moderate atopic dermatitis. Approval expands Opzelura's use in Europe and adds a new dermatology revenue opportunity for Incyte.
